title: Rep. Jimmy Gomez Resigns After Panel Alleges Unwanted Sexual Contact With Aide
summary: Representative Jimmy Gomez of California disputed the allegations from the Ethics Committee but said they left him with “no other alternative than to resign, effective Dec. 1.”
body_markdown: Representative Jimmy Gomez of California disputed the allegations from the Ethics Committee but said they left him with “no other alternative than to resign, effective Dec. 1.”
